jobs.description: Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you interested in high-tech technology? Then this could be your next step. As an Assembler at ASML, you will work on lithography machines that are used to produce microchips for the world's most advanced technologies. You will work in ASML's cleanroom factory, a unique and highly technological working environment where precision, quality, and teamwork are essential. You do not need to know everything from day one. At ASML, you learn by doing and develop your skills step by step through training, guidance, and hands-on experience. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and become part of a team that builds complex systems with the highest level of accuracy. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for someone who enjoys practical technical work and takes pride in delivering high-quality results. You are comfortable working with your hands, have an eye for detail, and understand the importance of working accurately when assembling complex systems. You enjoy working as part of a team and are willing to help colleagues when needed. At the same time, you take responsibility for your own work and are not afraid to ask questions or take initiative when you encounter a problem. You remain calm when priorities change and approach technical challenges in a practical and structured way. You are eager to learn and open to feedback. Whether you are already experienced in mechanical assembly or are looking to take the next step in your technical career, your motivation and willingness to develop are important. Education and technical experience A vocational qualification (MBO level 3 or 4) or a bachelor's degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive, Aerospace, or a comparable discipline. Hands-on experience in a technical production or service environment. Experience with mechanical assembly, testing, adjustment, and troubleshooting. Experience working with both larger mechanical components afine mechanical parts. Ability to read and understand technical drawings and work instructions. Good command of English, both written and spoken, for daily communication and documentation. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will work in a unique high-tech environment where you can develop your technical skills and contribute to technology that is used all over the world. You will receive extensive training and guidance and have the opportunity to build a long-term career within an international organization. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €3,771, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance. An additional 0.65% ADV allowance. A 13th-month salary. An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines play a crucial role in the production of microchips, which are used in virtually all modern technologies. As an Assembler, you are an essential part of this process. Your craftsmanship, precision, and attention to detail ensure that complex components and systems are assembled correctly and meet ASML's high quality standards. Every component you assemble contributes to a larger system, and every system contributes to the technology that enables the next generation of microchips. Your hands. Your craftsmanship. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow. Functieomschrijving After completing a solid training program at the ASML Academy, you will be ready to start working independently within the production environment. As an Assembler, you will build complex systems step by step, following clear work instructions and technical drawings. Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit? You start your day by checking the schedule and work sheets, so that you know exactly which small components you will be assembling and welding today. With your Level 1 experience in MIG/MAG welding, you ensure that each component is carefully assembled and welded. You set up the welding equipment correctly and constantly check the quality of your work. It's not just about welding, though. You assess how the various components fit together, check that everything aligns properly and ensure that the end product meets the specified requirements. You work with precision and quickly spot when something isn't quite right. Where necessary, you adjust your working method or the equipment settings. You'll also work with a circumferential welding robot to carry out repetitive tasks efficiently and accurately. You'll ensure the components are positioned correctly, keep a close eye on the welding process and check the end result. In this way, you'll combine your own craftsmanship with modern production technology. During your work, you'll be in regular contact with colleagues in production to find the best solutions together. If something doesn't go as expected or you spot an opportunity to tackle the work more efficiently, you'll discuss this with one another. The atmosphere is open and collegial: we work hard, but always with a sense of enjoyment and a good dose of humour. At the end of your working day, you can look back on tangible results.
